stemMd: A fair six-sided die is rolled twice. What is the probability that the sum is 9?
explanationMd: The favourable ordered pairs are (3,6),(4,5),(5,4),(6,3), four of the 36 equally likely pairs. The probability is 4/36=1/9.

distractorRationale.c: This assumes six favourable pairs instead of four.
distractorRationale.d: This double-counts the ordered favourable pairs.
distractorRationale.a: This counts only three favourable pairs.
